# Sakai Ichimonji Mitsuhide

> > Premium Japanese chef knives handcrafted in Sakai, Osaka since 1953, featuring over 2000 traditional and modern blade designs.

Sakai Ichimonji Mitsuhide is a heritage Japanese knife manufacturer showcasing traditional knifemaking expertise through an extensive product catalog, educational resources, and direct chef partnerships. The site serves both culinary professionals and home cooks seeking authentic Japanese kitchen knives with detailed guidance on selection, maintenance, and craftsmanship.

## Core Collections

- [Collections](https://global.ichimonji.co.jp/collections): Main product collections including Gyuto, Santoku, Wa-Gyuto, and Wa-Santoku
- [Japanese Kitchen Knives](https://global.ichimonji.co.jp/collections/japanese-knife): Complete Japanese kitchen knife collection with care and selection guidance
- [Deba Knives: Japanese Fish Filleting Knives](https://global.ichimonji.co.jp/collections/deba-knife): Deba knife collection for fish filleting and seafood preparation
- [Yanagiba Sashimi Knives](https://global.ichimonji.co.jp/collections/yanagiba-knife): Traditional Yanagiba knives for precise sashimi and sushi preparation
- [Usuba Knife: Japanese Vegetable Knife (Single Bevel)](https://global.ichimonji.co.jp/collections/usuba-knife): Usuba and Kamagata vegetable knives for precise cutting and peeling
- [Sakimaru Takobiki](https://global.ichimonji.co.jp/collections/sakimaru-takobiki): Sakimaru Takobiki sashimi knife for clean, precise fish preparation
- [Kiritsuke Yanagiba Knives: K-tip Sashimi Knives](https://global.ichimonji.co.jp/collections/kiri-tsuke-sashimi-knife): K-tip Kiritsuke Yanagiba knives for sushi and sashimi slicing

## Learning & Guides

- [How to Choose a Japanese Kitchen Knife for Beginners](https://global.ichimonji.co.jp/pages/choose-japanese-kitchen-knife): Beginner's guide to selecting Japanese knives: Santoku, Gyuto, Deba
- [Sakai Ichimonji Knife Guide](https://global.ichimonji.co.jp/pages/knifeguide): Comprehensive guide covering maintenance, history, techniques, and knife types
- [Maintenance](https://global.ichimonji.co.jp/blogs/maintenance): Knife maintenance, sharpening, and rust removal guides for all knife types
- [Japanese Knife Steel](https://global.ichimonji.co.jp/blogs/japanese-knife-steel): Technical reference on knife steel types, properties, and comparisons
- [Knife Gift Guide](https://global.ichimonji.co.jp/blogs/knife-gift-guide): Gift selection guide with etiquette and export regulation information
